source_caption_text:
#Peysoh Brought Out Colorado Springs Artist Lil Nate While On Tour Stop In The City 👀🔥

Peysoh is a Mexican-American rapper from Maywood, California, who became one of the more recognizable voices in the newer Los Angeles rap scene. Born December 23, 2003, he first gained major attention with his 2020 breakout song “6 Block.” His music is known for direct, autobiographical storytelling about his upbringing and experiences around Los Angeles. He followed his early success with projects including Ghetto Journal, Get Rich or Life Sliding, FinallyFed, and, most recently, BastardChild in 2026. 

Peysoh received a major mainstream boost when Kendrick Lamar featured him alongside Hitta J3 and YoungThreat on “GNX,” the title track from Kendrick’s 2024 album. Peysoh has also worked with artists including MoneySign Suede, Swifty Blue, Lil Yachty, Tyga and AZ Chike, helping connect his Maywood roots with the wider West Coast rap scene. 

 Lil Nate from Colorado Springs, Colorado is the rapper closely associated with the late Lil Travieso and the Colorado Springs rap scene.

Lil Nate began building attention at a young age through melodic West Coast-influenced street rap and frequent collaborations with Lil Travieso. The two appeared together on tracks including “Thuggin,” “4 Da Gang,” “Gangsta,” “Up All Night,” “Hit the Road,” and “Bag Chasin.” Their music accumulated millions of streams and views and helped bring more attention to Colorado Springs’ Hispanic rap scene. 

Lil Nate has spoken about how Lil Travieso was a close friend and important part of his musical come-up. In a 2024 interview, he discussed their early success together, his experiences entering the music industry while young, and how becoming a father gave him additional motivation to continue pursuing music. The interview also discussed his connection to a collaboration involving Lefty Gunplay and Lil Travieso. 

He remains connected to the broader West Coast-style rap movement despite being from Colorado, and his catalog with Lil Travieso continues to be some of the music he’s best recognized for.
